integrity: Finite exact checks supplement a complete analytic proof; no infinite result is inferred from finite enumeration.
scientific_limitations: Strictly increasing real knots and the probability-normalized Curry–Schoenberg spline are required; the Cauchy kernel order is n+m+1, n>=1, m>=0. Nonreal zero locations and simplicity are not classified. Earlier general spline identities and even homogeneous polynomial positivity are credited; independent publication-priority assessment outstanding.
title: Knot-invariant upper-half-plane zero counts for B-spline Cauchy transforms
